# dokku_resource_limit (Data Source)

Manages the resource limits for a given dokku application

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_resource_limit" "example" {
  app = "hello-world"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Name of the app

### Optional

- `process_type` (String) Process type to set resource limits for

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
- `resources` (Map of String) Map of resource type to quantity
